title: Territory Sales Officer
description:
Position: Territory Sales Officer General Trade Job Responsibilities: Drive territory sales, revenue growth and achievement of sales targets. Manage general trade channel operations and distributor relationships. Drive primary and secondary sales across the assigned territory. Expand retail reach through new outlet acquisition and market development. Ensure product availability, visibility and effective market execution. Note: This is an individual contributor role with no team management responsibilities.

Key Skills: Territory sales,Retail sales,Trade,TSO,FMCG sales,Sales,Territory,General
